title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Implementation Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reform of the Judicial Responsibility System
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Implementation Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reforms of the Judicial Accountability System

Fa Fa [2020] No. 26

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, and to fully implement the judicial accountability system, the Supreme People's Court has formulated the Implementation Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reforms of the Judicial Accountability System, based on the Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reforms of the Judicial Accountability System issued by the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and in light of actual work circumstances. The document is hereby issued to you. Please organize its implementation earnestly. Should any important issues arise during implementation, please promptly report them level by level to the Supreme People's Court.

Supreme People's Court
July 31, 2020

Implementation Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reforms of the Judicial Accountability System

In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, fully implement the judicial accountability system, and strive to enable the people to feel fairness and justice in every judicial case, the following opinions are put forward based on the Opinions on Deepening the Comprehensive Supporting Reforms of the Judicial Accountability System issued by the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and in light of the actual work of the people's courts.

I. Strengthening the Political Construction of People's Courts and Implementing the Main Responsibility for Full and Strict Governance over the Party

1. Persist in placing the Party's political construction foremost. Adhere to arming the mind, guiding practice, and promoting work with Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era; educate and guide the vast number of judicial officers to always maintain a high degree of consistency with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core in terms of political stance, political direction, political principles, and political path. Steadily advance the study of the Party's innovative theories, continuously conduct tiered and full-coverage political training, and achieve the institutionalization and regularization of learning and education. Strengthen awareness education of political organs, strictly enforce the Party's political discipline and political rules, guide judicial officers to adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work, adhere to the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, stay true to the original aspiration and mission, strengthen the "Four Consciousnesses," fortify the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds," ensuring that the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee are thoroughly implemented in the people's courts without exception.

2. Persist in selecting and appointing personnel with outstanding political standards. Adhere to taking political standards as the primary standard, improve the identification and evaluation mechanism for the political quality of court judicial officers, refine the content of assessments, optimize methods and approaches, enhance the scientific nature, precision, and operability of political quality assessments, and strictly adhere to political standards in selection and appointment, promotion and advancement, supervision and management, assessment and evaluation, training and development, commendation and reward, and other work. Explore the establishment of political quality files for cadres, strengthen regular assessment and inspection of political loyalty, political determination, political responsibility, political ability, and political self-discipline. Pay attention to grasping the specific performance of cadres at critical moments such as when undertaking major cases, completing major tasks, participating in major struggles, and facing major tests, and inspect and identify cadres through urgent, difficult, dangerous, and heavy tasks such as epidemic prevention and control.

3. Fully implement the main responsibility for full and strict governance over the Party. People's courts at all levels shall establish a responsibility list for full and strict governance over the Party, and improve a responsibility system for strict governance over the Party that is operable, supervised, and accountable. Strengthen regular political supervision and ongoing management supervision, strictly enforce organizational discipline, work discipline, and trial discipline, and severely investigate and punish violations of rules and disciplines. Strengthen the political functions of grassroots Party organizations, advance standardized and normalized construction, effectively enhance organizational capability, and fulfill the duties of directly educating, managing, and supervising Party members. In accordance with the requirements of being politically competent, professionally competent, responsible, disciplined, and conduct-wise, build a revolutionary, standardized, professional, and specialized court team that is loyal, clean, responsible, and respects and abides by the law.

II. Perfecting the Trial Power Operation System and Improving the Trial Supervision and Management Mechanism

4. Perfect the trial power and responsibility list. People's courts at all levels shall deeply grasp the relationship between fully implementing the judicial accountability system and strictly executing the principle of democratic centralism, refine and improve the court's own trial power and responsibility list, distinguish between types of personnel such as the president, vice presidents, full-time members of the Adjudication Committee, other members of the Adjudication Committee, division chiefs, deputy division chiefs, single-judge judges, presiding judges of collegial panels, primary judges, and other members, list item by item the specific powers and duties of various types of judicial personnel, and make detailed provisions on matters such as ensuring orderly and standardized exercise of power and strengthening trial supervision and management. Promote the embedding of job responsibility lists and performance guidance for court leaders and division chiefs (including full-time members of the Adjudication Committee, the same below), other judicial personnel, judge assistants, and clerks into the case handling platform, achieving that all types of performance can be prompted, traced, retroactively investigated, and supervised.

5. Perfect the mechanism for identifying and supervising the "four types of cases." People's courts at all levels shall, in combination with the court's tiered functional positioning and actual trial work, further refine and clarify the scope of the "four types of cases" stipulated in Article 24 of the Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Perfecting the Judicial Accountability System of People's Courts, improve the discovery mechanism, initiation procedures, and operational rules for the supervision and management of the "four types of cases" by court leaders and division chiefs, explore automatic identification and intelligent supervision of the "four types of cases," and enhance the informatization, professionalization, and standardization level of trial supervision and management. Each higher people's court shall establish a unified automatic identification and monitoring system for the "four types of cases." For cases where the trial organization should have reported but did not report, or should have submitted them to the specialized judge meeting or the Adjudication Committee for discussion but did not, the system shall automatically issue an alert and remind the court leaders and division chiefs to supervise.

For the "four types of cases," court leaders and division chiefs have the right to require the single-judge panel or collegial panel to report case progress and evaluation results. If they have objections to the trial process or evaluation results, they may submit the case to the specialized judge meeting or the Adjudication Committee for discussion; they must not require the single-judge panel or collegial panel to accept their opinions or directly change the opinions of the single-judge panel or collegial panel. When exercising their trial supervision and management duties, court leaders and division chiefs shall make annotations in the case files or on the case handling platform, leaving traces throughout the entire process. People's courts at all levels shall include the performance of trial supervision and management duties and the overall trial quality and efficiency in their respective fields of jurisdiction as important content in the comprehensive assessment and evaluation of court leaders and division chiefs.

6. Optimize the formation of trial teams. Basic and intermediate people's courts shall comprehensively consider factors such as personnel structure, case types, difficulty levels, and comprehensive research, adapt to the needs of dividing simple and complex cases and specialized division of labor, and flexibly form various types of trial teams. Strengthen the function of trial teams as units for handling cases and units for self-management, and reasonably determine the personnel ratio according to functional needs. With the principle of being optimized, collaborative, and efficient and conducive to supervision and management, further improve the internal organizational structure, rationalize the relationship between trial teams, trial organizations, and trial institutions, and ensure that the work powers and responsibilities of trial team leaders, single-judge judges, presiding judges, deputy division chiefs, and division chiefs are clear, reasonable, and orderly in the allocation of tasks. The allocation of judges and judicial support personnel can combine two-way selection with organizational allocation, granting judges the power to allocate work to judicial support personnel, the power to propose assessment suggestions, and a certain power to propose personnel management suggestions.

7. Perfect the case distribution mechanism. People's courts at all levels shall adhere to the principle of "random case distribution as the norm, designated case distribution as the exception." Where specialized collegial panels, specialized trial teams, or trial teams for small claims, expedited cases, and fast-track trials have been established, the matching method of case types shall be reasonably determined and human resources flexibly allocated, with random case distribution among different trial organizations as much as possible, avoiding a category of cases being handled by a fixed trial organization for a long time. For relatively fixed trial teams and collegial panels, personnel shall be regularly rotated. The circumstances of designated case distribution shall leave traces throughout the entire process on the case handling platform. If, due to reasons such as withdrawal, job transfer, health conditions, or integrity risks, it is indeed necessary to adjust the personnel of the trial organization after case distribution, the court leaders or division chiefs shall decide according to their authority, and the adjustment result shall be promptly notified to the parties and the reasons annotated on the case handling platform.

8. Perfect the case handling mechanism for court leaders and division chiefs. Each higher people's court shall comprehensively consider factors such as the number of personnel, case volume, areas of responsibility, supervision tasks, and administrative affairs, distinguish between different regions, levels, and positions, and scientifically and reasonably determine the standards for the number of cases handled by court leaders and division chiefs in courts under its jurisdiction. Court leaders and division chiefs shall not count presiding over or participating in specialized judge meetings, coordinating and supervising major sensitive cases, supervising the "four types of cases," receiving visitors, or directing enforcement as substitutes for the number of cases they handle, but such activities may be counted as workload and included in performance appraisal content.

Each higher people's court shall further refine the specific types of cases to be handled by court leaders and division chiefs in courts under its jurisdiction, improve the mechanism for case identification and distribution, and promote the realization of intelligent identification, tag processing, and automatic distribution. Court leaders and division chiefs at all levels of people's courts shall mainly handle designated cases, focusing on handling the "four types of cases" and cases remanded for retrial, etc. Court leaders and division chiefs of basic people's courts may also participate in random case distribution, but shall give priority to handling the aforementioned types of cases.

Each higher people's court shall establish a balance mechanism between supervision and management and case handling, optimize the duties of trial supervision, trial management, and administrative management of courts under its jurisdiction, coordinate to reduce the transactional workload of court leaders and division chiefs, and not participate in affairs beyond the statutory duties of courts and judges. The trial management department of the higher people's court is responsible for guiding courts under its jurisdiction in calculating and verifying the number of cases handled by court leaders and division chiefs. The trial management department of the higher people's court shall quarterly report on the completion of case handling tasks of the enrolled court leaders of the next lower people's court under its jurisdiction. The trial management department of the court itself shall regularly report on the completion of case handling tasks of division chiefs and deputy division chiefs.

9. Perfect the mechanism for unifying the application of law. Further improve the mechanisms for retrieving related cases and similar cases, the specialized judge meeting mechanism, and the Adjudication Committee system, ensuring that all mechanisms are organically linked and form a synergy. Through preliminary filtering by similar case retrieval, research and consultation by specialized judge meetings, and discussion and decision by the Adjudication Committee, effectively resolve differences within trial organizations, between different trial organizations, and between court leaders/division chiefs and trial organizations, promoting the unification of legal application standards.

The primary judge shall, in accordance with relevant document requirements, explain the situation in the collegial panel's evaluation, specialized judge meeting discussion, and trial report, or prepare a special similar case retrieval report, for cases requiring similar case retrieval. People's courts at all levels may, depending on the case type and the matters involved, convene cross-team and cross-division specialized judge meetings as appropriate. Higher people's courts, in order to promote unified application of law, may organize courts under their jurisdiction to convene cross-tier and cross-region specialized judge meetings for standardized types of cases. For cases that should be submitted to the Adjudication Committee for discussion and decision according to law but do not involve internal disagreements, the specialized judge meeting may not be convened for discussion. People's courts at all levels shall establish a practical and effective mechanism for resolving differences in the application of law, explore the establishment of channels for parties and other participants in proceedings to report inconsistencies in the application of law, and supporting mechanisms for monitoring, feedback, and disclosure.

Each higher people's court shall further standardize the procedures for issuing case handling guidance documents and reference cases, promptly file them with the Supreme People's Court, and eliminate unreasonable differences in case handling standards across different regions.

10. Strictly pursue accountability for illegal adjudication. Improve the working procedures for judge disciplinary action, perfect the procedural rules for investigation discovery, submission for review, deliberation and decision, and rights relief, adhere to the organic unity of serious accountability and legal protection, strictly distinguish between liability for quality defects in case handling and liability for illegal adjudication, refine the standards for dividing responsibility between judges and judicial support personnel, and enhance the professionalism, transparency, and credibility of judge disciplinary action. Each higher people's court shall actively promote the establishment of a judge disciplinary committee at the provincial level, further standardize the setup and composition of the disciplinary committee, cooperate in formulating the charter of the judge disciplinary committee at the corresponding level and the working rules for discipline, scientifically establish the office for judge disciplinary work, and formulate implementation rules.

Rationalize the relationship between investigations by the judge disciplinary committee and investigations by discipline inspection and supervision authorities, and between the review procedures of the judge disciplinary committee and the review procedures of discipline inspection and supervision authorities, ensuring clear powers and responsibilities and smooth connection. If during work, a people's court discovers clues of suspected disciplinary violations, duty-related violations, or duty-related crimes by judges or other court personnel, and such matters should be investigated and disposed of by discipline inspection and supervision authorities in accordance with relevant laws and regulations, it shall promptly transfer them. When discipline inspection and supervision authorities conduct investigations into suspected disciplinary violations, duty-related violations, or duty-related crimes by judges in accordance with the law, the judge disciplinary committee may provide review opinions from a professional perspective for the reference of the discipline inspection and supervision authorities.

III. Implementing the "Three Provisions" on Preventing Interference with Judicial Work and Strengthening the Construction of Integrity Risk Prevention and Control Mechanisms

11. Improve the working mechanism for implementing the "Three Provisions." People's courts at all levels shall strictly implement the Provisions on the Recording, Reporting, and Accountability of Leading Cadres Interfering in Judicial Activities and Intervening in the Handling of Specific Cases, the Provisions on the Recording and Accountability of Internal Personnel of Judicial Organs Asking about Cases, and the Several Provisions on Further Regulating the Contact and Conduct between Judicial Personnel and Parties, Lawyers, Special Relationship Persons, and Intermediary Organizations, and the implementation measures thereof. Ensure smooth operation of the direct reporting system for information, establish a system for monthly reporting and "zero reporting" of interference and asking about cases, and improve the mechanism for protecting and incentivizing judicial personnel who record illegal interference and asking about cases. Include the circumstances of court personnel illegally asking about cases and interfering in case handling, as well as the circumstances of case-handling personnel recording such inquiries, into the responsibility system for Party conduct and integrity construction and the performance assessment system, directly link them with the departments' leadership teams fulfilling their main responsibilities, and use them as important bases for evaluating and assessing cadres. It does not constitute illegal asking about and interfering in cases when higher people's courts perform their duties of supervising and guiding lower courts, or when court leaders and division chiefs perform trial supervision and management duties within the scope prescribed by the court's trial power and responsibility list.

12. Improve the integrity risk prevention and control system. People's courts at all levels shall fully leverage the comprehensive effectiveness of intra-Party supervision, disciplinary inspection supervision, and internal supervision within the political and legal system, intensify accountability and disciplinary action for violations of rules and disciplines, and adhere to zero tolerance in punishing judicial corruption. Review key nodes such as case handling procedures and trial period management, analyze and assess the possible case handling risks at each node, strengthen intelligent early warning of trial risk monitoring, and promote the early detection, early warning, and early handling of judicial integrity risks.

13. Perfect the mechanism for consciously accepting external supervision and constraints. People's courts at all levels shall consciously accept supervision by the People's Congress, democratic supervision, public supervision, media supervision, and legal supervision by the procuratorial organs in accordance with laws and regulations, ensuring that trial activities are carried out orderly in an environment subject to supervision and constraints. Implement the People's Assessors Law, earnestly carry out the selection, participation in trials, training, management, and publicity of people's assessors, and ensure the effective participation of the people in and supervision of judicial work. People's courts at all levels shall actively utilize the "four major platforms" for judicial openness, actively construct an open, dynamic, transparent, and convenient sunshine judicial mechanism, and expand the breadth and depth of judicial openness.

IV. Improving the Personnel Classification Management System and Strengthening the Construction of the Performance Guarantee System

14. Advance the dynamic management of judge quotas. The judge quotas for people's courts at or below the provincial level shall be managed comprehensively by the higher people's court within the approved total amount. In principle, they shall be reasonably allocated and dynamically adjusted within the provincial scope, based on cities divided into districts (prefectures) as units. The allocation of judge quotas for basic people's courts shall be mainly based on the approved establishment, total case handling volume, and average number of cases handled per judge; for higher and intermediate people's courts, the allocation of judge quotas may appropriately consider the workload of providing professional guidance to lower courts.

The allocation of judge quotas shall be tilted towards grassroots and frontline trial units. The proportion of judge quotas in higher people's courts shall not be higher than the average level of basic people's courts under their jurisdiction. When higher people's courts adjust and allocate judge quotas of courts under their jurisdiction, they may adjust the use of reserved judge quotas or comprehensively adjust already allocated judge quotas. Judge quotas reserved by higher people's courts for dynamic adjustment shall not be used for the court itself in principle. After the dynamic adjustment of court quotas, the calculation base of the judge rank ratio of the relevant courts shall be adjusted accordingly in a timely manner. The number of judge rank positions in courts with reduced quotas may be gradually resolved.

15. Advance the dynamic management of special political and legal affairs staffing quotas. Each higher people's court shall strengthen communication and coordination with the provincial establishment department, clarify the method of collaborative management, improve the working operation mechanism, rationalize the approval procedures for establishment matters, and properly resolve the problems faced after the reform of provincial-level unified management of special political and legal affairs staffing. Within the total amount of special political and legal affairs staffing of courts, adhere to the principle of overall consideration, highlighting key points, and seeking truth from facts, comprehensively consider factors such as jurisdiction area, natural conditions, population size, economic and social development level, case volume, and existing establishment numbers, and tilt the allocation of staffing towards regions and courts with larger average case handling volume per person. Adhere to the principle of revitalizing existing stock, dynamic adjustment, and optimizing structure, comprehensively consider the balance, accuracy, and synergy between the adjustment of judge quotas and the allocation of special political and legal affairs staffing within the province (autonomous region, municipality), strengthen the scientific management of special political and legal affairs staffing, promote the orderly flow of staffing resources, and improve the efficiency of staffing utilization. Rely on the personnel information management system, promptly update staffing and quota information, and accurately and comprehensively grasp changes.

16. Improve the judge selection system. Each higher people's court shall establish a mechanism for regular supplementation of judges, regularly conduct selection for reserved or vacant quotas in courts under its jurisdiction, and conduct judge selection in principle no less than once a year; explore the conduct of cross-regional judge selection; selection of judges across different cities within a province shall be reported to the higher people's court for approval; selection of judges across different provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities) shall be reported to the Supreme People's Court for approval. During the judge selection process, when recommending candidates to be selected as judges to the provincial judge selection committee, factors such as the average case handling workload per judge and the number of judges expected to retire soon may be comprehensively considered, and alternate candidates may be recommended at a ratio not exceeding 30% of the number of vacant judge positions. Before the next selection process is initiated, if judge quotas are vacant, candidates to be selected as judges may be directly recommended from the alternate candidates, and their appointment procedures shall be processed after being reported to the higher people's court for approval in accordance with the procedures. If they are not selected as judges through the alternate mechanism, they shall participate in the next judge selection according to the same procedures and standards as other personnel.

17. Improve the judge withdrawal mechanism. Judges holding leadership positions who do not handle cases, whose case handling does not meet requirements, or who handle cases in name only or falsely, and refuse to rectify, shall withdraw from the quota. If a judge meets the circumstances for withdrawal from the quota, but the court where the judge serves does not initiate the withdrawal procedure, the higher people's court shall promptly urge it. If a judge has objections to the decision involving their own withdrawal from the quota, they may apply for review to the court where they serve within seven days of receiving the decision. After a judge withdraws from the quota, if it is necessary to relieve them of their legal position, the relevant removal procedures shall be promptly initiated. A judge who withdraws from the quota due to the opinion of the disciplinary committee may reapply for the quota five years later, or two years later if they withdrew due to voluntary application or failure to meet performance assessment standards for case handling.

18. Improve the system for progressive selection of judges. Implement the provisions of the Judges Law on progressive selection of judges, improve the working mechanism for judge assistants of higher people's courts to participate in the selection for quotas in lower people's courts, and improve the supporting guarantee policies for the progressive selection system of judges. Judge assistants of the Supreme People's Court and higher people's courts who are first-time judges shall, in principle, serve in basic people's courts, but may also serve in intermediate people's courts as needed.

19. Regulate the procedures for job rotation and appointment. Where judges of people's courts at various levels are reassigned by organizational arrangement to non-case-handling positions or transferred out of the court system due to work requirements, and return to case-handling positions within five years of exiting the post and meet the conditions for being a judge in the court of their new post, the High People's Court shall approve or decide their entry into the post; if the aforementioned personnel have exited the post for more than five years, they must return to the case-handling position in the court and participate in case handling for a full year, and after passing the performance assessment, the procedures for entering the post shall be handled in accordance with the aforementioned procedures. Where, due to work requirements, personnel are transferred to case-handling positions at the same level or a lower level within the province (autonomous region, municipality directly under the Central Government) or across provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government), or are selected through cadre selection and appointment procedures to case-handling positions in a higher-level people's court, and meet the conditions for being a judge in the post of the new court, the High People's Court shall approve or decide their entry into the post; those selected and appointed to serve as judges in a higher-level people's court through the step-by-step selection procedure shall be considered as judges in the post, and the procedures for appointment of adjudicative positions shall be handled in accordance with the statutory procedures, without the need to handle additional procedures for entering the post. Where cadres assigned by the organization to temporary posts in case-handling positions in the court meet the conditions for being a judge in the court of the temporary post, the High People's Court shall approve or decide their entry into the post; where cadres in temporary posts enter the post, they shall not occupy the post quota or staffing numbers of the temporary court.

20. Regulate the management of judicial support personnel and judicial administrative personnel. Judge assistants under the central political and legal special establishment shall be managed as civil servants in comprehensive management categories, and shall simultaneously be subject to rank management. On the basis of strict political and capability assessment and strengthened management, explore the establishment of mechanisms for law faculty, students from law schools, and other personnel to engage in exchanges, internships, and serve as judge assistants in courts. Court clerks shall generally possess a college degree or above, proficient shorthand skills, and certain legal expertise. Except for some case-handling positions that require the retention of court clerks within the political and legal establishment due to confidentiality or other needs, in principle, court clerks shall no longer occupy the central political and legal special establishment, and may be managed through methods such as employment contracts or employee systems based on actual circumstances. Court clerks within the establishment shall be managed as civil servants in comprehensive management categories, and shall simultaneously be subject to rank management. Promote the timely transfer of eligible court clerks within the establishment to become judge assistants. Formulate management measures for police auxiliary personnel, specifying job responsibilities, management methods, etc. Strictly control the proportion of judicial administrative personnel; in principle, judicial administrative personnel in primary people's courts shall not exceed 15% of the central political and legal special establishment. Actively facilitate channels for the exchange of judicial administrative personnel with judges and judicial support personnel.

People's courts at various levels may, based on actual circumstances, implement rank management for court clerks and police auxiliary personnel outside the establishment, continuously improve incentive measures, coordinate with local finance, human resources and social security departments, and include the necessary funds for court clerks and police auxiliary personnel outside the establishment in the court's annual budget for comprehensive guarantee; reasonably determine the salary standards for court clerks and police auxiliary personnel outside the establishment, and establish a dynamic adjustment mechanism, and improve the assessment mechanism linked to work performance. Strengthen social insurance benefits such as basic old-age, medical, unemployment, maternity, and work-related injury insurance, as well as housing provident fund and other social security benefits for court clerks and police auxiliary personnel outside the establishment.

21. Improve the management system for the separate judge rank sequence. The Supreme People's Court, in conjunction with relevant departments, shall formulate relevant regulations on the management of the separate judge rank sequence. Judges shall be managed according to the separate rank sequence, adopting a combination of regular promotion and selective promotion; judges in front-line case-handling positions who are particularly outstanding or whose work requires special treatment may be specially promoted. Selective promotion shall be controlled within the prescribed proportion or quantity scope, and particularly outstanding judges shall be encouraged to undergo special promotion, which may break through the qualification requirements or skip grades. Where a judge's annual assessment is determined to be basically competent, no annual assessment is conducted, or the annual assessment results in no grade, that assessment year shall not be counted towards the tenure for promoting the judge's rank. During the period of a disciplinary or administrative sanction, promotion of the judge's rank shall not be permitted.

Where judges are transferred to judicial support positions, judicial administrative positions, or to other Party and government organs due to work requirements, based on the approval authority for judge rank promotion, and comprehensively considering conditions such as service qualifications and work experience, the corresponding rank shall be determined by comparison: first-grade and second-grade senior judges may be determined as first-grade and second-grade inspectors; third-grade and fourth-grade senior judges may be determined as first-grade to fourth-grade researchers; first-grade to fifth-grade judges may be determined as first-grade to fourth-grade principal staff members. Where personnel are transferred to professional and technical or administrative law enforcement positions, the rank shall be determined by reference to the relevant principles for transfer to comprehensive management positions.

22. Improve the compensation and benefits system. Implement and improve the relevant policies on old-age insurance following the pilot reform of the separate judge rank sequence, perfect and implement the salary system supporting the separate judge rank sequence, promote the implementation of the normal adjustment mechanism for judges' salaries, and when the salary standards for other civil servants are adjusted, correspondingly adjust the salary standards for judges. The distribution and granting of performance assessment bonuses for judges shall follow the principle of "highlighting actual performance, rewarding the excellent and punishing the inferior, and tilting towards the front line," and shall not be linked to the rank of the judge, and attention shall be paid to tilting towards front-line case-handling personnel. People's courts at various levels shall, based on actual circumstances, reasonably determine the grade level standards and personnel proportions for reward-based performance assessment bonuses, truly creating distinctions and reflecting differences. Where disciplinary or administrative sanctions are imposed due to violations of laws or discipline, reward-based performance assessment bonuses shall not be granted during the period of influence; if the period of sanction is less than one year, the reward-based performance assessment bonuses shall be reduced on a proportional basis. High People's Courts at various levels shall actively seek support from local Party committees and governments, strengthen communication and coordination with organization, finance, human resources and social security departments, and fully implement the benefits such as medical care, travel, public transportation subsidies, and housing that support the separate judge rank sequence.

23. Improve the performance assessment system. People's courts at various levels shall follow the laws of justice, comprehensively consider factors such as the number of cases handled and the quality and efficiency of case handling, differentiate personnel categories, job characteristics, and case types, and develop performance assessment methods that are hierarchical and graded, highly targeted, have reasonable grade differentials, and are simple and easy to implement. The performance assessment of judges shall combine quantitative and qualitative methods, with a primary focus on quantification, scientifically formulate and use quantitative indicators, adopt calculation methods such as weighted measurement, and reasonably set weight ratios. The performance assessment of judges includes basic contents such as the number of cases handled, quality of case handling, efficiency of case handling, and effect of case handling. People's courts at various levels may make corresponding adjustments based on the focus of trial work.

Where judges participate in special tasks, trial research, professional guidance, etc., as assigned by organizational arrangements while completing their case-handling tasks, assessment indicators shall be scientifically set to comprehensively reflect the workload of judges. Explore embedding intelligent applications into case-handling platforms to automatically capture case-handling and office data, generate assessment processes in real-time, dynamically update assessment content, and disclose the entire assessment process to ensure that assessment results are objective, precise, and traceable. Judge assessment shall combine regular assessment with annual assessment, with annual assessment based on regular assessment. The assessment results shall be recorded in the trial performance file and serve as an important basis for rewarding, punishing, promoting, adjusting positions and ranks and salaries, off-the-job training, removal, demotion, and dismissal of judges. Where the assessment fails, the position shall be adjusted, the rank shall be lowered, performance bonuses shall be suspended, or the judge shall exit the post in accordance with regulations.

24. Strengthen protection for the performance of duties according to law. Further clarify the responsibilities of the Judge Rights and Interests Protection Committee, improve the working mechanism, and strengthen safety education and training. Where judges suffer false reports due to performing duties according to law, people's courts at various levels shall coordinate with relevant units to timely clarify the facts, eliminate adverse effects, and pursue the responsibility of the relevant units or individuals in accordance with the law. People's courts at various levels shall, in accordance with the law, improve the joint defense and linkage mechanism with public security organs, strictly punish in accordance with the law the criminal acts of threatening, intimidating, insulting, slandering, retaliating, and violently assaulting court police officers and their close relatives; where court police officers and their close relatives are personally threatened, coordinate with local public security organs to take necessary protection measures; seriously implement the guiding opinions on severely punishing crimes of assaulting police in accordance with the law, and strengthen the protection of judicial police in performing their duties. Promote the improvement of special subsidy policies for court police officers who are injured or killed in the line of duty. Actively implement the central policies on pensions for judges and judicial police who die in the line of duty, and conscientiously carry out the application, distribution, and filing of the "two funds." Further regulate supervision, inspection, and assessment work, resolutely clean up and cancel unreasonable and unnecessary assessment items and indicators, effectively reduce the burden on the grassroots and relieve pressure on police officers.

V. Optimize the Mechanism for Allocating Judicial Resources, Effectively Improve Trial Efficiency

25. Improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism. People's courts at various levels shall, in accordance with the requirements of building a one-stop diversified dispute resolution and litigation service system, actively improve the diversion and connection mechanism between litigation and non-litigation dispute resolution methods, strengthen online diversion of litigation and non-litigation and the connection between litigation and mediation, accelerate the connection of the court mediation platform with non-litigation dispute resolution platforms such as arbitration institutions, notary offices, people's mediation, administrative mediation, and industry mediation, fully utilize online platforms, and integrate dispute resolution forces such as law societies, industry associations, industry organizations, chambers of commerce, and lawyers to achieve the diversified resolution of a large number of disputes before litigation. For types of disputes such as marriage and family, road traffic, property disputes, consumer disputes, labor disputes, medical disputes, banking and insurance, securities and futures, strengthen connection with relevant departments, establish and improve online and offline pre-litigation joint mediation mechanisms, clarify detailed rules for procedural connection, and promote efficient resolution of disputes before litigation.

26. Deepen the complexity-simplicity split in cases. People's courts at various levels shall strengthen the effective connection between the diversified dispute resolution mechanism and the complexity-simplicity split mechanism. Based on the requirements for the split of civil, criminal, administrative, and enforcement cases according to complexity and simplicity, specific standards may be formulated in conjunction with local conditions, and algorithms for the complexity-simplicity split system may be developed and embedded into the case filing system, forming a mode of "intelligent identification as the mainstay, supplemented by manual diversion." Improve the incentive mechanism for applying procedures, accurately distinguish between "complex cases" and "simple cases," establish scientific and reasonable case-handling assessment indicators and mechanisms, and guide parties and encourage judges to choose small claim procedures and summary procedures to handle cases in accordance with laws and regulations through methods such as fast trial and fast enforcement and performance incentives. High People's Courts in areas piloting the reform of the split of civil litigation procedures shall strengthen the guidance and management of the pilot, study and formulate implementation rules, encourage exploration and innovation, and lay the foundation for promoting legislative amendments. Courts in non-pilot areas shall, without exceeding the scope of laws and judicial interpretations, actively learn from the experience of pilot courts and prepare for promotion.

27. Promote the intensive and socialized management of trial support affairs. People's courts at various levels shall, based on actual circumstances, identify the scope and items of trial support affairs suitable for purchasing social services, carry out the purchase of services from society in a standardized and orderly manner, establish and improve systems such as open bidding, operational supervision, and business training, and include the necessary funds in the court's annual budget for comprehensive guarantee. Improve the workflow for intensive management of trial support affairs, explore the formation of professional work teams to handle tasks such as document service, property preservation, and enforcement investigation and control in a centralized manner.

28. Strengthen the construction of a smart data middle platform. High People's Courts at various levels shall, relying on the construction of smart courts, vigorously promote the application of blockchain technology in courts within their jurisdiction, actively explore in-depth applications of smart contracts, and strengthen the construction of a smart data middle platform based on the judicial big data management and service platform. People's courts at various levels shall further explore and expand the application forms of modern technologies such as artificial intelligence and 5G in trial work, promote in-depth applications represented by automatic cataloging of electronic case files, online file review, auxiliary generation of legal documents, and automatic generation of electronic archives, and improve the case filing method of "electronic archives as the mainstay, paper archives as a supplement."

People's courts at various levels shall fully recognize the significant importance of deepening the comprehensive supporting reforms of the judicial responsibility system, effectively strengthen organizational leadership, conscientiously fulfill the main responsibility, closely combine with actual work, grasp the implementation of this implementation opinion, give play to the breakthrough and guiding role of reform, and rely on reform to respond to changes and open up new horizons. High People's Courts at various levels shall take the initiative to act, eliminate the mindset of "waiting, relying, and asking," firmly rely on the leadership of Party committees, actively seek support from governments and other aspects, combine with local conditions, do a good job in basic work, improve supporting implementation rules, effectively strengthen reform supervision, fully mobilize the enthusiasm, initiative, and creativity of courts within their jurisdiction, and seriously promote the implementation of reform measures that courts themselves can take, ensuring that each specific reform task is grasped, detailed, and implemented. For new issues and new situations encountered in the implementation of this Implementation Opinion, people's courts at various levels shall seriously study and make recommendations, which shall be summarized by the High People's Court and promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court.

This Implementation Opinion shall come into effect on August 4, 2020. Where previous regulations are inconsistent with this Implementation Opinion, this Implementation Opinion shall prevail.
